text: gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.interface show-battery-percentage true; zenity --info --text="VALUE=$(gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface show-battery-percentage)"
memo: Typed combined re-set + zenity verify command in terminal (focused). Next: press Enter, then read the zenity dialog text: it should read VALUE=true. Note top-bar System menu width stayed 106px (VM may have no battery, so no % shown even when key is true).
